items.title: Casey’s General Stores (CASY) Grew EBITDA 17.1%. Can Fuel Sustain Growth?
items.summary: Casey’s General Stores, Inc. (NASDAQ:CASY) reported fiscal first-quarter revenue of $5.68 billion on September 8, while EBITDA increased 17.1% to $485.1 million. EBITDA is a company-defined non-GAAP measure that adds net interest expense, income taxes, depreciation, and amortization back to net income. GAAP net income rose 27.1% to $273.7 million.
